scope: Corrected post-build EVD driver and its two root review repairs

findings.reason: Only explicit unexecuted corpus records without either path or digest are omitted; any partial, missing or tampered declared artifact remains rejected.
Existing negative directories reject before source probes or copy; no recursive removal remains in the driver.

observations: Original native/property inputs are digest-bound, supplied to the strict producer, and checked unchanged at completion.
Output placement protects original native/property and declared artifact paths before failure-stub writes.
Intentional tampering occurs only in a new copied negative bundle; final positive consumer validation must still succeed.
Optional policy/replay attachments retain unsupported-semantic status and do not promote approval.
A stale own qualification result is explicitly replaced by failure before validation.
limitations: The eight focused driver methods are not native renderer executions.
Fresh integrated canonical/post-CI qualification remains a separate gate.
Whole-programme result remains partial or fail; no human, institutional or submission approval is inferred.
